ideas.title: Benchmark-driven evidence generalization beyond static benchmark
ideas.rationale: Recent abstracts in multimodal reasoning repeatedly emphasize evidence and benchmark; this suggests a likely next stage in next 6 months.
ideas.approach: Build a shared training/evaluation pipeline that couples evidence modules with benchmark signals, then run ablations on compute cost, robustness, and transfer.
